findings.issue: `hom_ext_completion_of_isLocalization` (and `hom_ext_toCompletionLoc`, TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/LocalizationTopology/Completion.lean:338) invert the shape this repo already uses for exactly this lemma — continuous ring homs out of a completion into a Hausdorff semiring agreeing on a dense sub-object. The existing pair is `weightedRestrictedSubring_ringHom_ext_of_continuous` (TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/WeightedRestrictedSeries/Basic.lean:1031) and `completion_weightedRestrictedSubring_ringHom_ext_of_continuous` (TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/WeightedEval/Completion.lean:82): object first, `ringHom_ext` (the maps are `→+*`), continuity named by `_of_continuous`. The new names put `hom_ext` first, drop `ring`, and leave the continuity hypotheses unnamed; every other `hom_ext` in the repo is either the bare name inside an object namespace or `<qualifier>_hom_ext`, never `hom_ext_<x>`.

summary: No notation is introduced and the prior module-name mismatch is gone (the file was folded into `Completion.lean`, whose docstring now matches its contents).
